messages:
rae (DevEx): New user reporting our quickstart fails on first request with HTTP 403 / {"error":"billing_required"}. They used the Python sample from README.

rae (DevEx): curl they ran: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer rwd_test_abc' -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```

omar (SDK): 403 billing_required usually means workspace payment not active yet or token minted before billing webhook. Do we know if workspace was SSO-created?

mai (Support): Reporter said org created via SSO and added card. Console shows "billing_pending" banner. Admin hasn't clicked Accept.

rae (DevEx): They assumed adding card was enough; quickstart didn't surface the Accept TOS step. Users confused.

omar (SDK): Short fix: map billing_required/403 to a clearer SDK error with actions (ask admin to Accept Billing Terms or run `rwd workspace refresh --wait-billing`). Also add 3 fast retries in SDK when token type is service-account. I'll open PR.

billing-bot: Billing webhook received: workspace w-praline-3 -> active (delay 18s).

mai (Support): Workaround for support replies: ask admin to accept TOS, or wait ~20s and retry. We'll add KB entry.

rae (DevEx): I'll update quickstart README with a troubleshooting blurb: "If you see 403/billing_required after creating a workspace via SSO, ensure an admin accepts Billing Terms in Console -> Billing."

omar (SDK): PR created to show friendlier message and retry logic (PR #4217). CI queued.

rae (DevEx): Reporter verified after ~30s retry call succeeded. Closing support loop. :tada:
